title: 기름때 확 줄이는

subtitle: 굽기만 하고 청소는 미루셨죠?
scene: A bright Korean home kitchen in the morning, one compact matte white basket-type air fryer on a light beige quartz countertop, a wooden cutting board and a small green plant nearby, warm sunlight streaming from a window on the left, soft natural tones, lower third of the frame is clean empty countertop
cover_image_prompt: The white basket air fryer stands in the center of the sunny kitchen countertop, basket slightly pulled out showing a clean shiny interior, a few roasted sweet potatoes on a plate beside it, warm morning light, no text, no faces

tips.title: 식으면 바로 닦기
lines: 다 쓰고 식으면 그날 바로 닦아요
tips.image_prompt: Hands pulling out the cooled air fryer basket and wiping it with a soft dish cloth, light grease visible, same kitchen set, no faces

tips.title: 바스켓 불리기
tips.image_prompt: The air fryer basket soaking in a sink basin of warm soapy water with gentle bubbles, same sunny kitchen, no faces

tips.title: 베이킹소다 활용
tips.image_prompt: A hand sprinkling a spoonful of baking soda into the air fryer basket filled with warm water on the countertop, no faces

tips.title: 열선 위 먼지 털기
lines: 플러그 뽑고 식힌 뒤 부드러운 솔로
tips.note: 전원 연결된 채로는 절대 손대지 마세요
tips.image_prompt: The unplugged air fryer gently tipped on its side on the countertop, a hand using a soft brush near the inner top area, power cord clearly unplugged and coiled, no faces

tips.title: 종이호일 눌러 쓰기
lines: 예열 때 날려 열선에 닿는 걸 막아요
tips.image_prompt: Hands placing sweet potatoes on a parchment liner inside the air fryer basket so the paper is weighed down, same kitchen, no faces

tips.title: 벽에서 띄우기
lines: 열이 잘 빠져 기기에 무리가 덜 가요
tips.image_prompt: The air fryer placed with clear space between its back vent and the tiled wall, a hand pushing it slightly forward on the countertop, no faces

tips.title: 완전히 말려 조립
tips.image_prompt: The washed air fryer basket and tray drying upside down on a dish rack in the sunlight next to the air fryer, no faces

warning.title: 이건 절대 하지 마세요
warning.image_prompt: On the same countertop, a steel wool scrubber and an abrasive cleaner placed next to the air fryer basket, and the air fryer body near a full sink of water, slightly cautionary mood, no faces

caption:
에어프라이어 바스켓, 1년 동안 물로만 헹궜어요 😅
쓰고 식으면 그날 바로 닦는 게 제일 쉬워요.
찌든 때는 뜨거운 물+세제나 베이킹소다로 불려 주세요.
열선 위 먼지는 꼭 플러그 뽑고 식힌 뒤 털어요.
종이호일은 음식을 올려 눌러 쓰고, 뒤쪽은 벽과 띄워 두세요.
여러분 집 에어프라이어는 몇 년 됐어요?
